# Bug Report

Thank you for helping improve AERIQ.

Before submitting, please confirm that this issue is a software bug and
does not contain passwords, API keys, customer data, farm credentials,
or security vulnerabilities.

> **Security vulnerabilities must NOT be reported through public issues.**
> Please follow the AERIQ Security Policy and use Private Vulnerability
> Reporting when available.
